text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and Stock E after sizable gains felt satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; consider each holding's prospects and my overall plan.","I sold Stock D and Stock C for small gains, yet the account later moved down and up; a sale does not guarantee better results, so avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations.","Past price changes do not predict future changes. I should follow a consistent plan rather than check prices often or try to lock in every gain."]}
